verdict.rationale: Docs describe the pieces of a payroll run — GET upcoming/unprocessed payrolls (review), pre-built Flows covering 'payroll processing' end-to-end, and off-cycle payroll creation via POST — suggesting a review→submit flow exists, but the evidence never shows an explicit 'preview totals' step for a regular payroll (only a contractor-payment preview endpoint is documented), nor any hands-on UI walkthrough proving hours/earnings review and submission happen in one seamless flow for an ops user. Community feedback includes vague complaints about payroll being 'screwed up' at times, but nothing pinpoints a failure in this specific review-preview-submit flow, so it doesn't rise to a documented dispute. missing for 10: explicit preview/totals endpoint or UI step for regular (non-contractor) payroll, and independent hands-on confirmation that the full cycle works in one flow.
